description: GRAPH-RESIDENT ABSTENTION ON A DISCONTINUED PRIOR (VISION_CUT_ABSTENTION_PREREG.md, seeds 73000-73999). THE DEFECT: VISION_VERDICT_RESULTS.md section 5.1 measured that across a scene cut the comparator is confidently wrong on 99.4% of trials and abstains on none of them, while VISION_SALIENCE_RESCORE_RESULTS.md section 4 measured that at short delta misidentification is not a REGION property but a FRAME event -- every one of 16 regions failing at once, per-frame error count tracking per-frame motion at r = +0.987. That is a CLIFF, and abstention is what converts a cliff into a degradation. THE DECISION IS A RULE, NOT A PYTHON CONDITIONAL. The adapter ingests frames and steps and draws a `spans` edge from each probe to the steps of its own interval -- mechanical translation of an interval the runner constructed. Everything after that is the graph's: it computes the motion of each step (ca_step_mag / ca_step_res), derives its OWN threshold from the sequence's own distribution (ca_otsu), marks the steps that exceed it (ca_mark_cut), and refuses any probe spanning a marked step (ca_abstain). THE THRESHOLD FALLS OUT (protocol section 13). NO NUMERIC THRESHOLD IS WRITTEN ANYWHERE IN THIS FILE, and a gate asserts that: `ca_otsu` takes the Argmax over the held steps of Otsu's between-class variance, rescaled by N^2 to the single-division form (s0*n1 - s1*n0)^2 / (n0*n1), and the threshold IS the `mag` of the step the graph picked -- a value the data supplied, not a number chosen to make an output look right. Verified before the seed was written: this reproduces the numpy Otsu's PARTITION exactly on both corpora (C1 high steps [34, 47, 79], C2 [23, 85, 143]) while the threshold VALUE differs, because the seed picks the lower endpoint and numpy picks the midpoint between consecutive distinct values -- the classification is unchanged by that. TWO STATISTICS, BOTH DECLARED IN ADVANCE. `mag` is the mean absolute per-pixel difference, computed by the graph via the existing TemporalDiff Term; it is by construction the same statistic the verdict rung computed in numpy, so the graph's value is checkable against it. `xcorr` is 1 - the peak axis-shifted correlation via the existing XCorrPeak Term (a lag sweep over the row index; applied to the transpose it sweeps columns), i.e. the change NOT explained by a rigid shift. The second exists because the first cannot distinguish a discontinuity from a fast pan -- a distinction the pre-registration predicts the primary statistic will FAIL, and which is the arm that decides whether this mechanism has learned `broken prior` or merely `large change`. THE ABSTENTION IS RECORDED. VISION_REDUNDANCY_RESULTS.md ARM 4 found observability 0/2 with the marker inventory EMPTY in all 26 probe runs INCLUDING BASELINE -- there is no vocabulary in this system for recording that a fallback occurred, so a silent degradation is indistinguishable from a healthy run. `ca_abstain` therefore mints a Refusal node (add_node_if_absent, so exactly one per group and the fixpoint terminates) and draws a `refused_by` edge, and sets `abstain_reason` on the group. The node type, the edge type and the answer value are all matched by the UNCHANGED marker regex of scripts/redundancy_observability.py, which is the existing reader this rung reports the inventory count from -- a marker no existing reader consumes would be a different kind of nothing. SHIPS OFF (CutParams.armed is the empty string, matching no arm) and is NOT in the default boot set -- the runner loads this manifest explicitly and arms it, so the inert configuration is byte-identical to the verdict rung's V3 and every committed result reproduces (protocol section 9).

rules.name: ca_step_mag
rules.comment: THE PRIMARY STATISTIC, COMPUTED BY THE GRAPH. mean |b - a| per pixel over the step's two frames, via the existing TemporalDiff Term -- the temporal face of change-detect, already in the engine and used unchanged. The adapter writes the frames' pixel values and NOTHING derived from them; the motion is the graph's own quantity. Deliberately the SAME statistic the verdict rung computed as np.mean(np.abs(frames[t+1]-frames[t])), so it can be checked against a reference rather than trusted. Guarded on CutParams.armed so the seed is inert until a measurement arms it (protocol section 9).

rules.name: ca_step_res
rules.comment: THE SECONDARY STATISTIC (S1), DECLARED IN THE PRE-REGISTRATION UNCONDITIONALLY AND REPORTED EITHER WAY -- it is not a rescue held in reserve for a failed primary. 1 - max(XCorrPeak(rows), XCorrPeak(cols)): the change NOT explained by a rigid axis-aligned shift. The distinction it is aimed at is the one the primary CANNOT make: a fast pan IS a shift, so its residual is small however large its raw motion; a cut is not a shift of anything, so its residual is large. XCorrPeak is the existing matched-filter Term (a peak-NCC sweep over integer lags of the row index); handing it the transpose sweeps columns instead, so the pair covers both axes with no new Rust. THE DECLARED WEAKNESS, stated before measuring: xcorr_peak does NOT mean-centre its inputs, so it is cosine similarity on all-positive luminance and may saturate near 1 for any pair of natural frames, leaving no usable dynamic range. Whether it does is a measured property of an existing Term and is reported as one.

rules.name: ca_otsu
rules.comment: THE THRESHOLD, AND IT FALLS OUT OF THE DATA (protocol section 13). Otsu's criterion maximises between-class variance w0*w1*(m0-m1)^2 over candidate splits; multiplying through by N^2 and clearing denominators gives (s0*n1 - s1*n0)^2 / (n0*n1), the SAME argmax in one division, where n0/s0 count and sum the steps at or below the candidate and n1/s1 those above. The candidates are THE OBSERVED MAGNITUDES THEMSELVES -- Argmax ranges over the held FrameStep nodes -- so the threshold is not a number in this file, it is the `mag` of a step the graph picked. There is NO free parameter and no percentile: a percentile would be a number I chose, and Otsu's split is determined by the distribution's own bimodality. The n1 > 0 guard is arithmetic (the topmost candidate has an empty upper class), not a tuned exclusion. Fires only once every step has been measured (the zero-pending guard), so the fixpoint orders the layers with no adapter sequencing. THE HONEST LIMIT, pre-registered as an expected FAILURE rather than discovered afterwards: Otsu has no free parameter but it also has no NULL HYPOTHESIS -- it returns a split on any distribution, including a sequence with no cut in it at all, and the cut-free control arm exists to measure exactly that.

rules.name: ca_mark_cut
rules.comment: A step whose motion strictly exceeds the graph's own derived threshold is marked. The comparison is against CutParams.cut_threshold, which ca_otsu wrote from the data -- nothing here is compared against a literal.

rules.name: ca_abstain
rules.comment: THE ABSTENTION -- THE DECISION TO DECLINE, AND IT IS THE GRAPH'S. A probe group that has reached vd_final (so the verdict seed's own measured-noise-floor refusal has already had its say) and that SPANS a step the graph marked as a discontinuity has had its frame-to-frame prior invalidated, so its identity claim is void and the answer becomes 'refused'. The rule reads only graph state: the group's status, the group's own spans edges, and the is_cut mark another rule wrote. NOTHING here is a Python conditional on motion magnitude -- the adapter drew the spans edges for an interval it had constructed and then stopped. AND THE ABSTENTION LEAVES A TRACE, which is the point: a Refusal node is minted (add_node_if_absent dedups on the author's attrs, so exactly one per group and the fixpoint terminates), a refused_by edge is drawn, and abstain_reason is set. VISION_REDUNDANCY_RESULTS.md found the marker inventory EMPTY in all 26 probe runs including baseline -- an abstention that leaves no trace in graph state is exactly the silent-degradation problem this is meant to fix. The ca_status guard makes the rule fire exactly once per group; identified_as is deliberately LEFT INTACT, so the graph still holds what it WOULD have said and the cost of the abstention stays measurable.
